_comment: Short, plain-language versions of the 50 norms in src/norms/norm_descriptions.json, shown to participants in place of the full text (which spells out cell coordinates, quadrant boundaries and exact queue paths). The LLM judge saw the FULL text; the human sees this. Keep each one to the rule itself, no geometry.
zigzag_right2_line: Agents waiting for the counter must line up in a single queue along a fixed path of cells that starts right in front of the counter. A newcomer joins at the end of the line and moves up one cell at a time, only when the cell ahead is empty. Standing off the path, waiting near the counter off the path, or cutting ahead is a violation. The line here has a zigzag (snake) shape that winds away from the counter, starting to the right.

A newcomer joins at the end of the line and moves up one cell at a time, only when the cell ahead is empty. Standing off the path, waiting near the counter off the path, or cutting ahead is a violation. Unlike a normal queue, the line here does not start in front of the counter: its head is right beside the counter on the left, against the wall, and the line runs along the wall away from the counter.
edge_right_line: Agents waiting for the counter must line up in a single queue along a fixed path of cells. Standing off the path, waiting near the counter off the path, or cutting ahead is a violation. Unlike a normal queue, the line here does not start in front of the counter: its head is right beside the counter on the right, against the wall, and the line runs along the wall away from the counter.
movement_clockwise_move: Agents must move around the room clockwise, and only along the walls: every move has to stay on the outer ring of cells next to the walls, never cutting through the middle of the room. Moving counterclockwise, or leaving the ring (except to step onto it from a door or to take the final step onto the goal), is a violation.
movement_counterclockwise_move: Agents must move around the room counterclockwise, and only along the walls: every move has to stay on the outer ring of cells next to the walls, never cutting through the middle of the room. Moving clockwise, or leaving the ring (except to step onto it from a door or to take the final step onto the goal), is a violation.
movement_no_odd_turn: Agents may only move on even-numbered turns (turn 2, 4, 6, …). On every odd-numbered turn (1, 3, 5, …) every agent must stay still.
movement_no_even_turn: Agents may only move on odd-numbered turns (turn 1, 3, 5, …). On every even-numbered turn (2, 4, 6, …) every agent must stay still.
movement_no_turn_mod3_0: Agents may not move on any turn whose number is a multiple of 3 (turn 3, 6, 9, …). On those turns every agent must stay still; on all other turns agents may move freely. The turn number is the shared global step counter.
movement_no_turn_mod3_1: Agents may not move on any turn whose number leaves a remainder of 1 when divided by 3 (turn 1, 4, 7, 10, …). On those turns every agent must stay still; on all other turns agents may move freely. The turn number is the shared global step counter.
movement_no_turn_mod3_2: Agents may not move on any turn whose number leaves a remainder of 2 when divided by 3 (turn 2, 5, 8, 11, …). On those turns every agent must stay still; on all other turns agents may move freely. The turn number is the shared global step counter.
movement_move1_wait1: Agents must never move on two turns in a row. After each move an agent must wait at least one turn before moving again (move, wait, move, wait, …). This is counted on each agent's own moves, not on the global turn number; waiting longer is always allowed.
movement_move2_wait1: Agents must never move on three turns in a row. After moving on two consecutive turns an agent must wait at least one turn before moving again (move, move, wait, …). This is counted on each agent's own moves, not on the global turn number; waiting longer is always allowed.
movement_move3_wait1: Agents must never move on four turns in a row. After moving on three consecutive turns an agent must wait at least one turn before moving again (move, move, move, wait, …). This is counted on each agent's own moves, not on the global turn number; waiting longer is always allowed.
xcell_must_visit: Each agent must visit at least one cell of zone Q before sitting down.
xcell_forbidden: Agents may never step on any cell of zone Q. The zone is completely off-limits.
occupation_region_capacity_1: Zone R (the yellow region) is the agents' goal area, but at most 1 agent may be inside it at any time. Agents must wait just outside until it is completely empty before entering and settling there.
occupation_region_capacity_2: Zone R (the yellow region) is the agents' goal area, but at most 2 agents may be inside it at the same time. If it already holds 2 agents, others must wait outside and may enter once there is room.
occupation_region_single_class_only: Zone R (the yellow region) is the agents' goal area, but it may only hold agents of one class (colour) at a time. If it currently contains agents of one class, only agents of that same class may enter; agents of any other class must wait outside until the zone is completely empty.
occupation_door_all_exit_A: All agents must leave the room through the left door, whatever their class or starting position. Leaving through any other door is a violation.
occupation_door_all_exit_B: All agents must leave the room through the bottom door, whatever their class or starting position. Leaving through any other door is a violation.
occupation_door_all_exit_C: All agents must leave the room through the right door, whatever their class or starting position. Leaving through any other door is a violation.
occupation_door_A_forbidden: No agent may leave the room through the left door. Everyone must exit through one of the other doors (bottom or right).
occupation_door_B_forbidden: No agent may leave the room through the bottom door. Everyone must exit through one of the other doors (left or right).
occupation_door_C_forbidden: No agent may leave the room through the right door. Everyone must exit through one of the other doors (left or bottom).
occupation_door_class_specific: Each agent may only leave through the door assigned to its class: orange agents through the left door, green agents through the bottom door, and blue agents through the right door. Leaving through another class's door is a violation.
occupation_door_class_specific_BCA: Each agent may only leave through the door assigned to its class: orange agents through the bottom door, green agents through the right door, and blue agents through the left door. Leaving through another class's door is a violation.
occupation_door_class_specific_CAB: Each agent may only leave through the door assigned to its class: orange agents through the right door, green agents through the left door, and blue agents through the bottom door. Leaving through another class's door is a violation.
occupation_seat_class_specific: Each agent may only sit on a chair in the part of the room assigned to its class: orange agents in the top-left area, green agents in the bottom-left area, and blue agents in the bottom-right area. Sitting outside the area assigned to one's class is a violation.
occupation_seat_class_specific_rot1: Each agent may only sit on a chair in the part of the room assigned to its class: orange agents in the bottom-left area, green agents in the bottom-right area, and blue agents in the top-left area. Sitting outside the area assigned to one's class is a violation.
occupation_seat_class_specific_rot2: Each agent may only sit on a chair in the part of the room assigned to its class: orange agents in the bottom-right area, green agents in the top-left area, and blue agents in the bottom-left area. Sitting outside the area assigned to one's class is a violation.
occupation_seat_bottom_left_only: All agents, whatever their class, may only sit on chairs in the bottom-left area of the room. Any chair outside that area is off-limits.
occupation_seat_no_bottom_left: No agent may sit on a chair in the bottom-left area of the room. Everyone must choose a chair outside that area.
occupation_seat_top_left_only: All agents, whatever their class, may only sit on chairs in the top-left area of the room. Any chair outside that area is off-limits.
occupation_seat_bottom_right_only: All agents, whatever their class, may only sit on chairs in the bottom-right area of the room. Any chair outside that area is off-limits.
occupation_seat_no_bottom_right: No agent may sit on a chair in the bottom-right area of the room. Everyone must choose a chair outside that area.
occupation_seat_in_order: Seats must be taken in a fixed order, column by column from the left: fill the leftmost column of chairs from top to bottom, then the next column to the right, and so on. Each arriving agent must take the next seat in that order after the last one filled, never an earlier one. A seat that becomes empty again is not reused; the order only moves forward, wrapping around to the first seat once the last has been filled.
occupation_seat_in_order_right: Seats must be taken in a fixed order, column by column from the right: fill the rightmost column of chairs from top to bottom, then the next column to the left, and so on. Each arriving agent must take the next seat in that order after the last one filled, never an earlier one. A seat that becomes empty again is not reused; the order only moves forward, wrapping around to the first seat once the last has been filled.
